create_visual_cnn: create a VisualCNN module that encodes RGB and depth observations into a fixed-size embedding vector
build_visual_cnn_rgb_only: build a VisualCNN that processes only RGB observations with a 3-conv architecture and fully connected output
test_visual_cnn_forward: test the VisualCNN forward pass by passing a dictionary of RGB and/or depth observation tensors
review_visual_cnn_is_blind: review the VisualCNN is_blind property that returns true when no RGB or depth inputs are configured
summarize_visual_cnn: summarize the VisualCNN class that applies 3 convolutional layers followed by a linear layer for visual observation encoding
